manifest.method: For cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base under tiktoken 0.13.0, compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)) per frozen pair without special tokens; average within owner, then equally across the four owners, per tokenizer; report the maximum tokenizer mean as the headline.
